answer_1.quote: In this paper, we evaluate the performance of MBR decoding in document-level text generation tasks. Specifically, we propose MBR-OT, a variant of MBR decoding that uses an optimal transport distance as a utility function.
answer_1.outputs: document-level text outputs such as translations, simplified summaries, and dense image captions

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of MBR-OT on multiple directed text generation tasks: document-level machine translation, document-level text simplification, and dense image captioning.

answer_3.quote: CLAIR is used as the metric to evaluate the outputs. CLAIR uses GPT-4 as a judge to compute the utility of the caption.
methods: using GPT-4 as a judge to compute the utility of the caption
